ModMetaData.name: Research Fixer – Tech Progression
ModMetaData.author: Bolek98
ModMetaData.description:
Research Fixer puts mod content where it belongs in the research tree. Built for RimWorld 1.7, works on 1.6 too.
Many mods add guns, armor and buildings that need no research at all – a plasma rifle on day one – or hang spacer gear on a medieval research. Research Fixer finds them and fixes it.
WHAT IT DOES - Finds industrial and higher weapons, apparel and buildings from mods that can be made without any research. - Groups them into new research projects per mod and era (e.g. "Some Mod: weapons (spacer)"), placed in their own "Mod research" tab and connected to the right vanilla research (Gunsmithing, Charged shot, Flak armor, Powered armor, Electricity, Advanced fabrication …). - Finds things whose research is two or more eras below them (spacer armor behind Smithing) and adds the right vanilla research as a requirement. - Optional (off by default): newly researched things get a green NEW mark in the workbench "Add bill" menu and a dot in the Architect menu until you make or build them the first time – no more guessing what a research just unlocked.
YOU DECIDE - Nothing changes until you open the list and press Apply. Every group and every fix can be skipped. - No mod files are changed – turn the mod off and everything is as before. - Open it from the research window (button next to the search), from the bottom bar of Yet Another Research Tree, or from the mod settings.
WORKS WITH - World at Your Level and Smart Colonist Gear follow research – fixed items are locked correctly for raiders and colonists too. - Vanilla content and DLCs are never touched.
